author: James (IrwinJam)
hardware: Mixed by case: retained routes from AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS and improved routes from AMD Ryzen 9 3950X 16-Core Processor (16 physical cores, 32 logical threads), Linux 7.0.0-34-generic, 67314638848 bytes RAM, CPU-only; see provenance.json.
method: Source-aware shortest-path-tree routing, negotiated congestion, exact per-net refinement, and bounded large-neighborhood search. Improved routes come from independent raw-input seeds with 600- or 1,200-second search budgets; only lower-delay legal routes unique among sibling submissions are retained.
